title: Quick Question About Building xDrip
symptom: User is having difficulty getting changes to the watch face to show up. They are unsure whether to build APKs or Bundles, and cannot uninstall applications on the watch.
fix: Connect the watch to adb and install the watch APK to the watch. If using Android Studio, there are two APKs that can be built.
evidence_quote: Start by connecting your watch to adb. See: https://developer.android.com/training/wearables/apps/debugging If you are using android studio, there are two apks that you can build. After that you can install the watch apk to the watch.
